title: Case 023: Unrecognised card purchase
initial_request: I want H&V to investigate a posted card purchase at Fern & Finch Books for £38.40 on 14 July 2025, which I do not recognise, and tell me how I can safely protect my card.
overview: Mara saw the purchase in her secure portal and raised the issue during a verified call after completing the bank’s identification checks. The agent opened a card-team case for that specific transaction. The case was registered, but the purchase’s ownership has not been established; neither fraud nor a refund has been confirmed.

next_action.summary: Open a card-team case against the specific posted purchase and provide the registration number in the secure portal.

outcome: The card-team case was registered as HV-023. No finding has been made about who made the purchase, whether it was fraudulent, or whether any refund is due.

events.body: I show a posted card purchase at Fern & Finch Books for £38.40 on 14 July 2025. Its appearance in your transaction list does not establish who made it.

After completing your identification checks, I’m calling to report that I don’t recognise the Fern & Finch Books purchase. Please raise it with the card team and tell me how to protect my card safely.

I am opening case HV-023 for review of Mara Ellery’s specific posted purchase at Fern & Finch Books for £38.40 on 14 July 2025. The customer says she does not recognise it; no conclusion about the merchant or the purchase has been reached.
I have registered case HV-023 for the specified card purchase. Registration records the enquiry only; it is not a finding of fraud or a decision to refund.

I have registered your card-purchase enquiry as HV-023. We have not established who made the purchase, whether it was fraudulent, or whether a refund is due. I can also guide you through H&V’s secure card-protection options; no card change has been made.
